correctness.rationale: For every m≥3 the exact all-one factorial moments of m marked matching pairs are c_r=(2(m-r)-1)!!/(2m-1)!!. Equality c_{m-1}=c_m forces any length-N exchangeable urn total to lie in {0,...,m-2,N}; the coefficient of total m-3 then gives a sharp obstruction N≤m+4. A degree-m-2 polynomial with coefficients q*binom(m+4,t)*S_{m-t}, plus q times the all-ones atom, matches all m moments. The all-index recurrence S_k=2(k-1)S_{k-1}+2(k+3)S_{k-2}+(-1)^k k(k-1)(k+1)/3 derives from the formal generating-function differential equation; its induction proves all coefficients nonnegative. The triangular moment inversion gives uniqueness. Cases m=1,2 have explicit infinite Bernoulli extensions. checker.py passed 1,258 independent exact assertions including matching enumeration; no finite test stands in for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural m-coordinate indicator family from a uniform perfect matching has positive pairwise correlation but finite exchangeability, with an unexpectedly universal exact four-coordinate reserve at every m≥3, a unique sharp extension and explicit implementable urn law. This sharp boundary gives a structural and quantitative example separating positive correlation from infinite exchangeability, and a reusable technique for support-rigidity and moment inversion. It is neither a reparameterized counting formula nor an arbitrary small test case.
